open_points.subject: import_snapshot
open_points.text: - import_snapshot: [BEHAVIOR] MUST read the current UTC time once per operation, by one call of utc_now, and use that single instant for every timestamp it writes and every current-time comparison it makes; it MUST NOT read a host clock itself.
open_points.other_text: def append_audit(repository: AuditRepository, intent: AuditIntent) -> AuditRecord
open_points.question: The required audit write produces an AuditRecord with occurred_at, but append_audit accepts no timestamp; which passage must change, or how can import_snapshot require append_audit to use its single utc_now instant?
